en: A sepia-toned photograph of a large brick building, partially obscured by trees and shrubbery. There are benches and a small garden area in the foreground, with steps leading up to the entrance. The building appears to be at least two stories tall, with a glass-enclosed veranda or sunroom on one side. The foliage suggests it is spring or summer. The border of the image is scalloped, typical of vintage postcards.
